svg.title: Four questions plotted on a flattened map of the 349 chunks, each with the 5 chunks Chroma returned circled. Total revenue lands inside the cloud and its results sit close together. The AI strategy question lands right on a chunk, with four close results and one stray. The R&D question lands in a gap and its results are spread out. The Michael Jordan question has nothing nearby, and its results come from all over the map.
svg.text: Where four questions land among the 349 chunks
lands inside the cloud: neighbors close together
lands right on a chunk: mostly close, one stray
lands in a gap: neighbors spread out
“What has Michael Jordan done for us lately?”
